userStories.title: Finalize resume-image consent and greeting safety
userStories.description: As a job seeker, I want every image and greeting to remain fail-closed so the extension never sends a resume image or unreviewed identity text without my explicit per-job approval.
acceptanceCriteria: The per-job review checkbox is unchecked every time the review opens
The immutable confirmation payload binds the selected checkbox state, reviewed greeting, and exact ordered image hashes
Preview, hashing, and actual image sending use the same canonical image bytes
No image storage is read by the send path when image sending is not approved
BOSS built-in auto greeting is read-only checked and blocks on enabled or unknown state at task start, before immediate chat, before worker send, and on captcha resume
Candidate, recruiter, client, former-employer, target-company, school, and branded-project identities are removed or cause final worker rejection when the final text differs from the reviewed text
Old job.aiGreeting and old automatic-resume consent cannot bypass the current review gates
npm test passes
node --check passes for every JavaScript and MJS file
git diff --check passes
userStories.notes: Implementation and post-fix local acceptance checks pass. The final runtime-enforced verifier found a P1 gap for standalone former-employer and branded-project resume lines; the root agent reproduced and fixed it with executable positive and negative regressions. Keep passes=false because the task-wide three-reviewer cap is exhausted and no fresh independent reviewer remains for the post-fix diff.
